verdict.rationale: Docs describe a genuine pre-filter architecture ('traverse and filter an exact candidate set before vector ranking, so results cannot escape graph or permission boundaries'), plus native support for filtering on both nodes and edges and combined graph/vector/text queries in one ACID transaction — this is the correct architectural pattern to avoid recall loss from post-filtering. However, there is no independent benchmark validating recall or latency under metadata-filtered vector search specifically, and community reports raise unrelated performance concerns on multi-hop queries and small benchmark datasets that add uncertainty about scale behavior. Missing for 10: independent recall/latency benchmarks for filtered vector queries, and confirmation the pre-filter approach holds up at scale.
